
# Fraud Graph Detector API

A lightweight high-performance FastAPI service detects potential circular flows of money (money laundering loops) in a graph using cycle detection algorithms (Depth First Search)․

Features
* Graph Engine: Uses adjacency lists and a depth-first search using a recursion stack to detect cycles․
* FastAPI Backend: Autogenerated API documentation (Swagger UI)․
* Production Ready: Deploy easily to cloud services‚ such as Render․

API Endpoints
* POST /check-transactions: checks whether there are cyclical money transfers among a list of transactions․
